items.comments: Taher was an amazing host who replied promptly to any questions I had. His place is in a prime location if you are staying in Seattle for a few days touring the city. My friend and I had no trouble getting around the city, whether it was by foot or bus. In addition, his place is very clean, and he makes you comfortable staying in his place. His place also offers an incredible view of Lake Union. I would definitely stay here again!

Taher was a great host. Our flight got in a little late and he still stayed up and let us in. Great location with easy access to the bus to downtown. Would definitely stay here again next time in Seattle!
